subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “People living in the same building were not just people behind doors.”?
options: They could become a small community.
She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.
Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.
Digital masks should not become excuses for cruelty.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「People living in the same building were not just people behind doors. They could become a small community.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Digital masks should not become excuses for cruelty.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「People living in the same building were not just people behind doors. They could become a small community.」，答案為「They could become a small community.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They could become a small community.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
